review.notes: Independent fixing review of the ArithmeticGaloisDuality package (README, Suggested.lean, metadata) against its accepted plan, by Claude (session claude-2nfoIZ), who did not write the package. Checked: upstream form; fidelity (all 125 plan titles matched by script; 129 targets after review; every definition has at least three Checks); own words (10-word shingles against ten source texts); process residue; tiers and supplier layers (every TauCetiRoadmap and atlas citation checked against the current roadmaps and lower packages); duplication against TauCetiRoadmap main, Tau Ceti a91d3aaf and the lower-tier packages; about 110 locators (all 41 Milne, about 45 NSW, Rubin, DDT, KW II, Conrad, BCGNT, Nakamura, Jannsen); and the adversarial mathematics pass on every target (table in the report). Fixed: rationalisation of lattice cohomology claimed no nonzero divisible elements for every profinite G (false for G = prod Z/p^j, i = 2; restated with Jannsen 4.9, new Check); the explicit Poitou-Tate pairing cocycle had the wrong sign for the ProfiniteCohomology Leibniz rule; roots after totally real base change now proved for all m by reduction to m prime (BCGNT 5.3.3), with Sha^2(F, Z/m) = 0 for m prime and a Q(sqrt 7), m = 8 obstruction Check; Nakamura comparisons now assume perfectness where p = 2 with a real place; inflation-restriction limit step via stable images; Lean isIndAdmissible_of_isAdmissible no longer assumes Module.Finite. Duplicates removed and cited: function-field Chebotarev (AGR Layer 5), H1(SL2(F), End0) = 0 (AGR 7.7 h1_SL2_adZero); number-field Tate vanishing and the trace pairing cited from AGR Layer 7; factor-set topology and inner conjugation cited from current Tau Ceti. Stale supplier ids replaced (AbelianSchemes A2.2, AlgebraicModuli 4.20, AGR Layers 2, 4, 7); ProfiniteCohomology layer numbers corrected (all-degree long exact sequence is Layer 10); two lower-tier roadmaps removed from downstream consumers; nine NSW PDF pages and two Milne pages corrected; every Lean declaration named in the README. lean-check before and after: exit 0, 35 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry'; intake check-files: 0 problems.
